nombre_oficial.texto: Palace of Cortés: Courtyards, Windows, and Halls

frase_gancho.texto: A fortress built over the Tlahuica seat of government.

introduccion_narrativa.texto: The Palace of Cortés is today the Regional Museum of the Peoples of Morelos. On the ground floor are the courtyards, the archaeological windows that reveal the pre-Hispanic plaza, and several halls on the nature and peoples of Morelos. Explore this part at an unhurried pace: here you can understand what stood before the palace and who has lived in this territory. This is where the layer of power begins.
